newsitem.title: FRANCE: France's Arthuis says recent dollar rise fair.
newsitem.headline: France's Arthuis says recent dollar rise fair.

text.p: French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis said in a newspaper interview published on Wednesday that he was pleased by the dollar's recent rise against European currencies, which he called a fair appreciation.

"At each G7 meeting we regretted the weakness of the dollar...so today, let's not spoil our pleasure. The current movement does not reflect a change in the German currency but simply a fair appreciation of the dollar," Arthuis said in an interview with local Lyon newspaper Le Progres.
At 1120 GMT, the dollar was worth 5.7570 francs and 1.7071 marks. The mark was at 3.3721 francs.
Le Progres published the interview with Arthuis on the day he is meeting with German Finance Minister Theo Waigel and Hans Tietmeyer, president of the Bundesbank in the central French city of Lyon.
Jean-Claude Trichet, governor of the Bank of France, is also attending the meeting.
